area: Builders and untrusted input: ZPA segment settings in bulk, the URL category analyzer beyond 2,000 URLs, ANY in pack level lists
title: Bulk ZPA segment edit on the shared engine (Browser Access, PRA and inspection segments kept intact), resumable URL lookups with bounded memory, ANY level lists normalised or refused

checks.what: ZPA segment settings in bulk out of scope (ZPA not ticked): plan and picker refused before anything is read
Unknown fields (name, domain_names), bad values, bad ids, bad port ranges and more than 200 segments are refused before a read

Against a fake whose update replaces the segment: every other setting, Browser Access apps (sent back as read), PRA and inspection apps survive; commonAppsDto is never sent; the read-back flags a dropped app
Preview keeps the last server group, the last port range, an application's port; refuses a domain on overlapping ports in two segments; skips read-only segments
Plan hash (moved tenant: plan_changed, nothing written), re-read conflict per field, exact Undo, the sample tenant through the installed SDK

Analyzer: 2,500 URLs in one run, 100 per request, progress logged; Continue sends no URL twice; a persistent 429 ends the run; a refused batch is not retried in a loop; Stop keeps what was looked up; a total bound with the count named
Checkpoints: in memory only, bound to actor, tenant and categories, expire, evicted by count and size; the job result carries only a token; a bad or foreign token is a 400 before sign-in
checks.standard: ASVS V4.2.1 · ASVS V8.3.1 · CWE-639 · CWE-200

checks.what: Packs: ["ANY"] trust / risk levels expanded in the pack reader, the deploy payload, the rule signature and Terraform; ANY mixed with levels, unknown levels and non-lists refused with the reason

findings.title: A literal ["ANY"] device trust or user risk level list in a pack was passed through to the API and to Terraform unchanged (the provider takes explicit values only)
findings.fix: pack_channels.normalize_levels / level_problem, applied in pack_deploy.load_pack_file, build_payload, policy_signature_extra and pack_terraform.load_pack

findings.title: The URL category analyzer kept sending lookup batches after ZIA refused one for its rate limit through every retry
findings.fix: lookup_batches(stop_on_rate_limit=True) ends the run; the unsent URLs are left for Continue

notes: Assumed (marked in ops_zpa_fields.py and url_tools.py): a PUT keeps a PRA or inspection segment's applications when it carries no commonAppsDto; sending a Browser Access segment's clientlessApps back as read is safe; the ICMP access values; a segment needs a port range and a server group, an application's port stays inside the TCP ranges, one domain is never in two segments on overlapping ports; a segment shared from another microtenant is changed only there; /urlLookup falls under ZIA's POST limit of 400 an hour.
The Endpoint DLP pack retired on 2026-09-11 is not restored; the reason and the replacement are on the pack library page and in POLICY_PACKS.md, for the owner to confirm.
